title: Commit explicit goals, constraints and versioned acceptance criteria
goal: Give a session an accountable user task whose criteria and resource choices can be refined without silently changing the goal.
scope: Implement Task, Goal, Assumption, Clarification, Constraints, Pins, Criterion and AcceptanceContract with stable identities and a content version. Cover NewBehavior, Preserve, ArtifactPresence, Quality and Constraint; required/weight/needs_class; User and Derived(Assignment) origins.

Provide trusted application operations to open and refine intake from explicit user data, commit criteria, record clarifications and assumptions, and expose the current contract. Validate finite weights/budgets, reserve within budget, positive limits, criterion references and compatible pins; preserve reason and prior contract references for substantive revisions.

Implement SessionStatus Intake/Running/Finalizing/Delivered/Blocked(Text)/Cancelled representations and intake projections without equating process exit with acceptance. This task owns typed user-origin intake and provenance representation; executable lifecycle/control behavior is W1-0014.
acceptance: Opening a session through Application with several criterion kinds persists and replays the exact goal, contract version, user pins, required evidence classes and limits.

User-origin refinement retains its prior contract/basis and records ClarificationRecorded or AssumptionRecorded. The Derived(Assignment) representation retains the precise assignment reference; actual charged Planner production and provenance validation are demonstrated in W1-0011, not fabricated here.

Invalid limits, duplicate/missing criteria and contradictory explicit pins cannot create partially committed intake. A revised criterion/contract receives a new attributable version and cannot silently inherit evidence for another interpretation.
context: Authority: ymp-docs/self-organizing-team-domain-model.md, sections 3.2, 3.3 (SessionStatus), 4 (AcceptanceAuthority), P6, A1 intake, A11 and R-3. Use the approved model with 811a872 semantics and the greenfield baseline in 0c61ff1 and §5.8 for experimental strategy boundaries. Other documents and existing names explain implementation facts only.

Greenfield: create this behavior in the new implementation. Paths below are PROPOSED target modules under the layout owned by W1-0001; only completed prerequisite tasks supply implementation. Prior source, APIs, fixtures and delivery claims are not a baseline.

Create proposed crates/ymp-domain/src/task.rs and crates/ymp-kernel/src/intake.rs, exposed through crates/ymp-runtime/src/application.rs. W1-0001 supplies values, Journal and deterministic projection contracts; W1-0016 persists the resulting payloads.

Implement explicit user goal/criterion/constraint input first. Reporting capacity is derived later by ResourcePolicy into Budget, not an obligatory Constraints field. W1-0011 owns admitted Planner extraction, Derived(Assignment) authorship and the invalid/foreign producer checks at that real integration boundary.
Development task records remain unrelated to product Task authority. Intake commits user scope; a future Planner proposal cannot silently override pins or replace the user goal.

history.note: Plan new implementation from greenfield baseline 0c61ff1, preserving approved experimental mechanisms, reporting/evidence/recovery rules and explicit prerequisite boundaries.
Start decision 2026-09-16: W1 scheduled; readiness follows dependencies.
